research_role: post-HYB-001/HYB-002 architecture design; no HYB-003 performance result exists
research_question: Does causally available text add net decision value beyond an otherwise identical Tech-state risk model while frozen Tech-Control is long?

rationale.hyb_001_failure: Entry veto/downsize converted noisy daily text into trade-long opportunity cost.
rationale.hyb_002_failure: A generic negative-event rule reduced exposure for one bar without conditioning on market state or the economic side and stage of the event.
rationale.replay_audit: Independent replay reproduced all 24 frozen shadow trades and the HYB-002 primary estimate; the negative result is not explained by quantity reconstruction error.
rationale.semantic_audit: The frozen liquidation_leverage bucket included bankruptcy, withdrawals, token unlocks and an explicitly bullish short-liquidation headline. Generic negative direction is therefore not a valid held-long action variable.

controlled_arms.T0: Frozen Tech-Control execution with no learned risk overlay.
controlled_arms.T1: Tech-state-only risk policy using the same learner, target, folds, tuning budget and action set as T3, but no text-derived fields.
controlled_arms.T2: Text-only diagnostic using the same target and temporal folds; not the primary comparator.
controlled_arms.T3: Tech-state plus causal text-state features and predeclared text-by-Tech interaction terms.

decision_contract.eligible_timestamp: Each 4h bar open strictly after a frozen Tech-Control entry and strictly before its shadow exit.
decision_contract.entry_authority: Tech-Control only; HYB-003 cannot create, reverse, delay or veto entry.
decision_contract.shadow_exit: All arms inherit the frozen Tech-Control exit timestamp and reason.
decision_contract.action_duration: One 4h bar; restore only if the shadow trade remains open.
decision_contract.event_order: shadow rebalance exit -> restore if required -> new overlay action -> funding -> shadow intrabar stop -> close mark
decision_contract.turnover_deadband: Act only when the training-fold estimate of net action advantage exceeds all registered round-trip execution costs plus a fixed uncertainty margin.

prediction_target.primary: Exact counterfactual net utility difference for exposure 0.5 versus 1.0 from the current bar open to the next 4h boundary or earlier shadow exit.
prediction_target.utility: Net PnL after adverse execution, fees and funding; drawdown is evaluated separately and is not folded into a tunable scalar.
prediction_target.why_aligned: The supervised target is the same marginal decision that the overlay is allowed to take, rather than unconditional market direction or generic sentiment.
prediction_target.label_construction: Event-driven paired replay under identical shadow lifecycle and execution semantics.
prediction_target.grouping: All rows from one shadow Tech trade form one dependence cluster.

tech_state_features_T1: asset identity encoded from the training fold only
distance to fixed/trailing shadow stop divided by ATR
past-only 4h returns and realized range at 4h, 12h and 24h horizons
current funding rate and past-only funding aggregates
frozen Tech rank/momentum score when materializable without future data

required_fields: held-long pressure: adverse, supportive, two-sided or unknown
mechanism: forced-long-selling, forced-short-buying, solvency, security-loss, protocol-outage, legal-restriction, flow-demand or other
event stage: rumor, initial-announcement, escalation, ongoing, resolution or retrospective
novelty versus prior causally available reports
source-domain count, model confidence and extraction reliability
causal_text_state_T2_T3.forbidden_shortcut: No action may be derived from generic sentiment, a generic negative direction field or event_type alone.
causal_text_state_T2_T3.unknown_handling: Unknown/two-sided pressure and missing/error extraction map to no-action evidence, not adverse evidence.
causal_text_state_T2_T3.aggregation: Deduplicate the same event across domains, preserve first availability, and decay event state only forward in time.

registered_interactions_T3: event stage x recent realized range
event horizon mass at 4h x action horizon
asset scope x held asset identity

learner_contract.family: Regularized linear conditional action-value model with calibrated uncertainty; no deep end-to-end trading agent.
learner_contract.same_capacity_rule: T1 and T3 use the same loss, temporal training windows, optimizer, regularization search budget and action threshold procedure.
learner_contract.selection: All regularization and deadband choices are nested inside expanding training folds.
learner_contract.embargo: At least the maximum target horizon plus one 4h bar between train and evaluation windows.
prohibited: Choosing text fields, horizons, thresholds or interactions after reading HYB-003 evaluation outcomes
Reporting in-sample action advantage as incremental value
Giving T3 a larger tuning budget than T1
Dropping losing assets, event mechanisms or folds after evaluation

incremental_value_gates.primary_contrast: T3 minus T1 paired mean net utility at the same eligible timestamps
incremental_value_gates.system_contrast: T3 minus T0 net portfolio performance under the same execution contract
required_for_development_pass: Lower bound of the 95% shadow-trade-cluster bootstrap CI for T3-T1 is above zero
Lower bound of the 95% shadow-trade-cluster bootstrap CI for T3-T0 is above zero
T3 has positive net contrast in at least two of three chronological folds
T3 beats timestamp-shuffled text, metadata-only text and delayed-text placebos
T3 portfolio intrabar MDD is no worse than T0 under one frozen MDD definition
Effective independent trade clusters meet a power-derived minimum frozen before evaluation
incremental_value_gates.interpretation: Passing only T3-T1 establishes text-feature increment over the risk model; it does not establish a useful trading system unless T3 also passes T3-T0 after cost.

stage_gates.requirement: Materialize a causal 4h Tech-state panel and a separate outcome-blind text-state extraction contract; audit timestamp, side/stage labels, deduplication and missingness.
Compute cluster count, intervention prevalence and minimum detectable effect without fitting T3. If power is insufficient, stop as INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
Freeze hashes, folds, learner, feature lists, target, costs, deadband procedure, placebos and exact assignments before reading evaluation metrics.
Run T0/T1/T2/T3 on already-seen historical data and label the result exploratory development only.
Only a frozen candidate that passes development may enter a newly dated prospective sealed holdout; missed historical dates cannot be backfilled.

known_feasibility.warning: The 525 eligible post-entry rows are nested in at most 24 trades and are not independent observations. Power must be based on trade clusters.
known_feasibility.status: No power pass has been established.

next_authorized_action: Materialize Stage A panel/schema audit and Stage B power analysis only; do not evaluate HYB-003 performance yet.
